jobs.title: 12064-1 - Creative/Marketing - Fabric R&D
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager of Fabric R&D

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand – our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About the Role

In this role, you are accountable for supporting the ideation, development, implementation and execution of the Gap Inc production and vendor capability strategy, delivering value through effectively balancing innovation, quality, and cost. You will be able to operate in a highly matrixed global organization, forming part of the cross functional product team (Design, Merchandising, Tech Design, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, Fabric Research and Development and Global Sourcing). You will be able to execute with strong attention to detail to ensure the product pipeline meets key milestones to meet product to market (P2M) demands.

What You’ll Do

· Understand product development implications on merchandising and design-driven product decisions based on category or vendor strategies and nuances.
· Drive communication between brand teams and Asia-based product teams to ensure strategic business alignment and optimal responsiveness.
· Understand and work with cross-functional teams to ensure financial targets are met by delivering on cost guidance.
· Provide flash garment costing, accurately accounting for all costing components.
· Manage BOM maintenance through PLM system to ensure product execution.
· Communicate with Asia-based teams to understand product execution issues and provide support in resolving them in a timely manner.
· Monitors P2M calendar milestones and escalates issues impacting deadlines.
· Support seasonal strategies to limit our exposure to buying fabrics pre line adoption, manage through liability as needed.
· Execute category product development strategies that align with production strategies and divisional goals.

Who You Are

· Global Product Development experience or exposure to driving global product development and understands design, merchandising, and vendor/category management.
· Problem Solver- can proactively solve problems and effectively manage multiple challenges. Anticipate and mitigate P2M risks by balancing cost, supplier and time constraints
· Collaboration- Proven ability influencing and making decisions cross-functionally in a matrix environment where speed and cultural sensitivity is crucial.
· Learning Agility- demonstrated curiosity, motivated to develop new skills and knowledge, with openness to feedback.
· Communication – communicate data and information to cross-functional partners in a clear manner to support decision making.
· Manage specific categories in coordination with a cross functional team and international sourcing partners.

jobs.title: 11985-1 - Change Management Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Seeking a Senior Change Manager to lead organizational change management (OCM) delivery across the NextGen Procurement transformation program. This enterprise initiative modernizes Gap's procurement operating model through sequential technology implementations — Zip intake orchestration, Coupa Supplier Information Management, and Ironclad Contract Lifecycle Management — serving procurement, accounts payable, legal, as well as various business functions and supplier-facing teams across the organization.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact engagement requiring expert change management execution across four concurrent releases culminating in an enterprise rollout by December 2026. The program will transform how Gap manages supplier relationships, contract execution, and procurement processes for thousands of users globally, making skilled OCM leadership essential to adoption success.
The right candidate brings direct experience supporting procurement or enterprise P2P transformations and can operate independently to manage content production, training development, and stakeholder coordination while collaborating closely with the Change Lead who handles strategic relationships and executive sponsorship.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own comprehensive communications production across all four releases — developing message strategies, creating publish-ready email campaigns, drafting town hall materials, and executing reinforcement communications tailored to procurement, AP, legal, supplier management, and business partner audiences.
• Design, develop, and coordinate training curriculum and content delivery for Zip, Coupa SIM and Ironclad CLM implementations, including foundational learning content, step-by-step user guides, quick reference materials, and enterprise training execution framework for integrated solution rollout.
• Execute detailed stakeholder impact assessments for contract management deployment, using current state vs. future state workflows for legal, procurement, and business functions to list and analyze change impacts, while identifying high-resistance stakeholder segments and change magnitude across process, tool, role, and data dimensions.
• Manage enterprise-wide coordination activities for global, multi-region deployment including cutover complexity planning, regional process variation management, multi-language material development, and coordinated change champion network operations across time zones.
• Drive readiness assessment and deliverable completion for enterprise rollout, ensuring all enablement materials meet publish-ready quality standards and coordinating with SI vendors (KPMG, Epiq) to ensure content integration and delivery excellence.
• Support integrated solution change management by managing compounded change from SIM→CLM→P2P workflow integration, developing orchestrated change sequencing to prevent user saturation, and creating end-to-end process training that builds on previous solution learning.
• Execute comprehensive program reporting and stakeholder participation including regular status updates, governance meeting participation, cross-functional coordination with product and technical program managers, and collaborative planning with Change Lead on strategy alignment.
• Handle localization requirements and ERC updates for international markets, developing region-specific content variations and managing enterprise communication platform coordination for global deployment success.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Human Resources, Communications, or related field.
• 5+ years of change management experience, with a minimum of 3 years specifically supporting procurement, supplier management, P2P function, or similar stakeholders through enterprise system implementations.
• Direct experience supporting enterprise platform implementations (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle Procurement, or similar platforms). Candidates must be able to credibly engage users on platform concepts without requiring technical onboarding.
• Experience independently owning content production at enterprise scale — communications strategies, training curricula, job aids, quick reference guides, and stakeholder materials — without reliance on separate instructional design or communications resources.
• Proven ability to manage concurrent project workloads with overlapping timelines, shared stakeholder populations, and coordinated communication strategies to prevent audience fatigue and message conflicts.
• Strong proficiency applying ADKAR or equivalent structured change methodology in fast-paced program environments within condensed go-live timelines and high stakeholder expectations.
• Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones, with demonstrated ability to coordinate content production and delivery for international audiences including localization requirements.
• Strong executive communication skills — comfortable drafting communications on behalf of senior procurement and technology leadership for enterprise-wide distribution.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Change management certification — Prosci ADKAR, ACMP, or equivalent.
• Experience supporting Coupa Supplier Information Management or Ironclad CLM implementations with direct knowledge of platform capabilities sufficient to explain change impacts to business users.
• Demonstrated experience supporting contract management or CLM platform migrations, including user training design, workflow change communications, and adoption tracking for legal and procurement contract management populations.
• Experience with Marketing Cloud or similar enterprise communication platforms for stakeholder communication delivery and campaign management.
• Background in retail, consumer goods, or multi-brand procurement environments with understanding of category management, supplier diversity, and global sourcing operations.
• Experience managing OCM coordination with system integrators and vendor-delivered content, including quality oversight and delivery timeline management for SI-produced training materials.
• Familiarity with SharePoint as a training repository, project communications platform, and change management resource distribution system.

The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. Oral Health Educator Job Description: Overview:\u2028The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. This position will focus on equipping Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), school nurses, educators, children and families, and community partners with the knowledge and skills needed to support oral hygiene practices, preventive care, and improved oral health outcomes. Responsibilities: ● Training & Education: Develop and deliver tailored workshops, and training sessions for CNAs, school nurses, early learning centers, and community partners on oral health best practices. ● Resource Development: Create and distribute educational materials such as guides, checklists, pamphlets, posters, videos, and digital content tailored to skilled nursing facilities, school settings, and families. ● Collaboration: Work closely with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) leadership, school administrators, healthcare professionals, and community organizations to align oral health education with patient care protocols, school health needs, and community-based initiatives. ● Oral Health Advocacy: Promote the importance of oral health in overall health, especially for elderly residents, chronically ill patients, children, and vulnerable populations. ● Support & Guidance: Serve as a resource to CNAs, school nurses, educators, and community partners by providing ongoing support, answering questions, and offering solutions to oral health challenges. ● Outreach & Events: Support planning, coordination, and participation in community outreach events, health fairs, school-based programs, and public health campaigns to expand oral health awareness and access. ● Program Support: Assist with program planning, preparation and distribution of oral health education materials, grant proposals, budgets, data collection, and reporting. ● Evaluation: Monitor and assess the impact of educational programs and outreach activities and recommend improvements to enhance care delivery, school-based prevention, and community engagement.
